definitions.explanation: A lake formed when rain or groundwater fills the crater of a volcano. Japan has many, such as the emerald-green Okama on Mount Zaō.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火口湖|かこうこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a crater lake at the summit.

examples.japanese: {火口湖|かこうこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑色|みどりいろ}→緑色：24190_midoriiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The water of the crater lake looked green.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{火口湖|かこうこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水温|すいおん}→水温：27380_suion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When volcanic activity increases, the temperature of a crater lake can rise.

notes:
⟦{火口|かこう}→火口：00448_kakou⟧ (crater) + {湖|こ} (lake).

- カルデラ{湖|こ}: caldera lake — fills a much larger basin left by a collapsed volcano, such as Lake Towada or Lake Kussharo
